crossRefs.note: “ ‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known…
“If anyone sins, doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, though he didn’t know it, he is…
“If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or…
or has found that which was lost, and lied about it, and swearing to a lie—in any of these things that a man sins in…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty,
translations.bsb: “Tell the Israelites that when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another, that person is guilty
translations.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
translations.asv: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Jehovah, and that soul shall be guilty;
